## POST `/103/settings/registration/performance`

**Tier:** T1+ (check: some POSTs are actions)  

Register or Deregister the passed in system id for performance stats collection. If the passed in systemId is ALL , it registers all local systems for stats collection. ## GET `/103/settings/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/access_control/authorization_rule`

**Tier:** T0  

**Lists authorization rules for the storage array.** **_Role Based Access Control (RBAC)_** is a critical framework for managing user permissions and access to resources within an organization. The access is managed per storage array. Authorization rules can be defined for individual users or a user group, which is specified with `account_type` value. In order to identify an individual user or group values such as: `name`, `authority` and `qualifier` are required. The `qualifier` specifies a **_domain_** or in case of a host-based access a **_host_** **_name_**. Supported `authority` types…

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `symmetrixId` | path | string | yes | symmetrixId |
| `name` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Authorization Rules based on the name of the user or group e.g. equal to "name=testUser" or contains "name=<like>test" |
| `account_type` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Authorization Rules based on the account type. Possible values are "user" and "group" |
| `authority` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Authorization Rules based on the authority. Possible values are "LocalDirectory", "ldapSSL", "windowsAD", "host", "sso", "none" |
| `qualifier` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Authorization Rules based on the qualifier e.g. equal to "qualifier=test" or contains "qualifier=<like>test" |
| `role` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display Authorization Rules based on the role e.g. "role=admin" |

## GET `/103/settings/symmetrix/{symmetrixId}/alert/system_threshold`

**Tier:** T0  

Lists system threshold configuration settings per storage array. **System thresholds listed are ALL thresholds available in the Unisphere release version. Thresholds that are applicable to the storage array have ```applicable``` property set to ```true```.** Single system threshold controls whether Unisphere alerts on a component if monitored values are out of range. The threshold can be based on: - storage array - monitors a specific aspect of the storage array ex. Local Replication Utilization - storage resource pool (SRP) - monitors specific aspects of all SRPs ex. SRP Effective Used…

| `name` | query | string |  |  |
| `applicable` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display System Thresholds that are applicable to the storage array (true/false) |

| `critical_threshold` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display System Thresholds that are lt, gt or eq to the specified critical threshold |

| `snmp_notifications` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display System Thresholds that have SNMP notifications enabled (true/false) |
| `syslog_notifications` | query | string |  | Optional value that filters returned list to display System Thresholds that have syslog notifications enabled (true/false) |
